Figure 1 is the conceptual model: the many-to-many relationships (assigned, maps to, tagged with, targets) are implemented by the junction tables AccountRole, CLOConcept, QuestionConcept and the legacy AssessmentConcept shown in Figure 2. SystemSetting stores historical/operational platform values; result release is no longer selectable. The four legacy tables (Assessment, AssessmentConcept, AssessmentQuestion and AssessmentBlueprint) are marked as historical rows only. Tables added by later migrations (account identity, role audit, OAuth handoff, login throttling, concept prerequisites, question translations, the frozen session question plan, session start-request bindings, evaluation records, grading jobs, grade reviews, grade-edit audit, result-release events, refresh sessions, system settings, password-reset tokens and password-reset audit) are documented in the sections below, and all 41 tables appear in Figure 2.
